applicable_sections: §4 director drafts and local machine authority
§7.1-§7.3 knowledge replay, provenance, and scoped capability knowledge

root_cause: The prior A1 knowledge schema could not canonically preserve field-level source provenance, complete candidate accounting, selection reasons, catalog index abstracts, or model/mode/aspect validity windows for platform capability knowledge. This enabled the later A3 service to create a parallel knowledge authority.
repair: KnowledgeCapsuleV2 now requires source_summary and immutable field_provenance bound to its declared SourceRef values.
KnowledgeCapabilityScope requires valid_from, valid_until, model, mode, aspect-ratio scope, and a source digest that must resolve to a capsule SourceRef.
KnowledgeCandidateRecord seals each candidate's immutable digest, source locators, and field provenance.

KnowledgeSnapshot now seals the complete candidate set, exact selected/excluded accounting, selection reasons, source-digest linkage from model view to candidate record, catalog index abstract, exclusions, conflicts, security event digests, and K1/K2 binding rules.
The model-facing KnowledgeDecisionView remains compact and unchanged; full provenance and retrieval replay data stay outside model input.

checks.name: canonical_artifact_envelope
checks.evidence: KnowledgeCapsuleV2 and KnowledgeSnapshot remain the exact canonical payload types for their ArtifactKind values; candidate and capability records are nested immutable values rather than new competing artifacts.

checks.name: canonical_24000_tick_timebase
checks.evidence: The registered A1 regression retains the one 24000 tick/s CanonicalTimeline and half-open TickRange invariants.

checks.name: draft_artifact_separation
checks.evidence: No model-facing KnowledgeDecisionView field was expanded with locator, provenance, candidate, security, or index data; those fields are retained only by KnowledgeSnapshot.

checks.name: no_duplicate_domain_authority
checks.evidence: Canonical domain type declarations remain unique and the ArtifactKind-to-exact-payload bijection remains mechanically verified. A3 is still responsible for replacing its service-local duplicate knowledge classes with these canonical types.

checks.name: domain_schemas_frozen_for_downstream
checks.evidence: New KnowledgeCapabilityScope and KnowledgeCandidateRecord are frozen dataclasses; nested mappings are deeply frozen and reject undeclared or unregistered source references.

checks.name: legacy_read_adapter_only
checks.evidence: The A1 legacy checkpoint adapter regression remains green and this repair does not add legacy runtime imports to domain or compat.

informational_results.name: compile_and_patch_check
informational_results.command: python -m compileall -q mode_p_vnext/domain mode_p_vnext/compat; git diff --check
informational_results.result: All touched domain and compat modules compile; no patch whitespace errors.

downstream_boundary: This A1 repair deliberately does not edit the A3-owned KnowledgeRetriever. Its current service-local KnowledgeStage, KnowledgeDecisionView, and KnowledgeSnapshot remain an unaccepted downstream defect and must be removed by the re-claimed A3 work package after A2 is revalidated.
